quotes.title: GJ 3929
quotes.card: GJ 3929, also known as Gliese 3929 and TOI-2013, is a red dwarf star located 51.6 light-years from Earth, in the constellation Corona Borealis.
quotes.introduction: With an apparent magnitude of 12, it is not visible to the naked eye.

notes: GJ 3929 c: found without a transit, and no paper's row measures its whole orbit together (period, eccentricity, periastron time and an inclination with an error bar) (found by radial velocity)
